scope: bench and first hardware bring-up only

trustzone.meaning: matches the current non-TrustZone bench image

bank_swap_initial.meaning: initial program starts from bank 1; application A/B logic may change this later

boot0_default.meaning: normal reset boots user flash while the fixture may assert BOOT0

write_protection.meaning: bench rework and A/B testing remain possible

preserve_fields_note: BOR, watchdog, SRAM and all unlisted option bytes must be read first and preserved unless a separately approved profile changes them.
procedure: Read and save the complete option-byte snapshot before programming.
Check the exact device identity STM32U585VIT6Q and stop on mismatch.
Apply only the listed controlled fields.
Reset the device, read all option bytes back and compare with the requested profile.
Attach the before and after snapshots, programmer version and probe serial to the unit record.
acceptance: The signed bench image starts from bank 1.
No Level 1 or Level 2 RDP transition occurred.
No WRP, PCROP, TZEN or BOOT_LOCK protection was enabled.
production_note: The production secure-root profile is a separate release decision. This bench profile does not claim immutable secure boot.
